name: FreeTube
hook: Subscriptions and history that live on your computer — not Google's servers.
bullets: Watch history and subscriptions stored locally
Ads and tracking blocked out of the box
Import your YouTube data in one click
setupSteps: Download FreeTube for Windows, macOS, or Linux
Import your YouTube subscriptions or start fresh
Watch with no account, no ads, no telemetry
details: FreeTube is a free, open-source desktop YouTube client for Windows, macOS, and Linux. It fetches videos through privacy-respecting instances while keeping your subscriptions, playlists, and watch history on your own machine. Ads, tracking, and recommendation manipulation are gone by design, and you can import your existing YouTube data to switch in minutes. SponsorBlock, dark theme, and multi-instance failover are built in.
